title: Typical expansive measures for infinite-dimensional maps
summary: A classical theorem by Mañé states that compact metric spaces admitting expansive homeomorphisms must be finite-dimensional. It is a natural question, raised by Morales and Sirvent, whether this dimensional constraint extends to the measure-theoretic notion of expansiveness. In this paper, we answer this question in the negative. We prove that the shift map on the Hilbert cube is expansive with respect to the product Lebesgue measure.
